build_hyperparameter_tuner: build a HyperparameterTuner with a worker pool to minimize a cost function over a search space
run_minimize_search: run the minimize method on a HyperparameterTuner to find the lowest cost across all overrides
create_local_executor_workers: create local process pool workers using build_local_executor_workers with a cost function builder
serialize_job_key: serialize a JobKey to a JSON string using to_str and deserialize it back with from_str
build_noop_checkpointer: build a no-op checkpointer using default_checkpointer_builder that discards all checkpoint writes
